Two models per game. Football and college basketball: ESPN's power index (FPI/BPI) and an opponent-adjusted ratings model built only from games already played. NBA and NHL: the ratings model and each team's last 10 games.

A game gets a call only when both models land on the same side by at least the bar: 3 points in football, 4.5 in basketball, 5 win-probability points in hockey. One model alone is a WATCH, never a bet.
Automatic pass: the two models are 10+ points apart. Any model 7+ points from the market is a re-check warning, not a reason to bet.

A main (cash) needs four things: both models agree, confidence 7.0+, no veto, and a sport you've approved (football and NBA now; CBB and NHL stay paper until you say 'approve CBB'). The past-games test still feeds confidence - a failing test cuts the score. Otherwise it is PAPER: tracked and graded, $0.
L-1112-1 (your call, 11/12): no $25 single on midweek or small-conference college football. Those need 8.0+.
Units never change on their own: $50 at 8.0+, $25 at 7.0-7.9, $15 parlays, 2 tickets per game, $180 day cap, stop at -$150. Never chase.
The first line logged for a pick is the one it is graded on. Every pick is also compared with the closing line, so we can see whether we got a good number.
Line movement is used only as a price check, never as a reason to bet.

Before every game the Board re-checks open picks. It can only say PULL (line moved past the playable number, or a new QB/star/goalie doubt) - it never adds a bet or raises a stake. Cash pulls email you.
You change settings by commenting on a GitHub issue: bankroll, skip, approve, unapprove, goal. Only your account counts.

Old setup: up to 10 ranked calls a day (the Top 10), the best up to 3 are mains ($50 at 8.0+, $25 at 7.0-7.9) plus 2 parlays at $15 with only one confident pick each. Mains count as placed unless you comment 'skip'. Once a main is logged it stays locked - only a PULL or your skip takes it out.

Props have their own section and card: up to 10 PLAYs a day, the card is 3 prop singles + 2 prop parlays (2-pick, one PLAY + one LEAN from different games), $15 each, max 2 tickets per game. Paper until you say 'placed Name'. A locked prop that goes bad before the game gets a PULL tag.

Our own history (old Board tickets + this Board's graded picks and props) nudges confidence by at most +/-0.5: last 60 days only, recent results count more, and the record is pulled toward break-even by 40 phantom games so a hot or cold streak can't take over.
Deep checks: main picks also look at each team's last 5 games; props also look at what each opponent gives up on that stat (capped at +/-10%) and flag boom-or-bust players.
